source.notes: For each sample landblock (A9B4, A90D, A99E, A9B0, C5F0, 03A7, 376A): LScape.get_landblock (PostInit), then LScape.get_landcell for each interior cell 0x0100 .. 0x0100 + NumCells - 1 (EnvCell PostInit). One case per body: in = {block, kind (object | scenery | interior), index (in its list; interior: in the block's cells in order)}; out = {id: PartArray.GetDataID(), cell: CurCell.ID, origin, rotation (w, x, y, z), scale, shadows: the ShadowObjects cell ids, ascending}. Landblocks the statics reach are loaded on the spot, as on the server.
